test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 18 May, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Find the part of the given sentence that has an error in it. If there is no error, choose 'No error'.**

All of the farmers I interviewed shared three things on common.
solution:
The erroneous part of the sentence is: "**things on common**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The correct phrase is '**in common**' instead of '**on common**'
 
• "**In common**" is the correct idiomatic expression to indicate that multiple farmers share certain things.
 
• The preposition "**in**" is used to show a connection or similarity between the farmers and the three things they share.
 
• 'In common' means shared or possessed by two or more people or things
 
• 'On common' is not a correct phrase in this context
 
• Therefore, the correct sentence should be "**All of the farmers I interviewed shared three things in common.**"

Hence, **option 4** is the correct answer.
